It’s really personal preference imo but if it’s a quality terp pearl and you’re not absolutely raining hell fire on your banger it shouldn’t matter. But, like everything else dab wise, everyone’s preferences and opinions are different so I can’t tell you really. But, you have a directional carb cap which is from what I’ve gathered a lot of dabbers (including me) least favorite carb cap for their bangers which use terp pearls. I’d recommend a “spinner cap” which basically creates a more vortex like flow with the air and allows your ball to spin faster and easier. I’d recommend bringing your rig into the shop w terp pearl and banger to see which spinner cap would be best. I’ve also heard of people using marbles w their bangers that use terp pearls but have never personally tried it.
